editorial:
Imagine walking into a hospital room and seeing a man in a coma who looks exactly like your missing husband or brother. Now imagine five other strangers walking in and saying the exact same thing. That is the wild setup of this thriller. You get to follow these six different people as they all fight to claim this unidentified man. The vibe is very tense and mysterious because you spend most of the time wondering who is lying and who is actually telling the truth. It feels like a giant puzzle where every new piece of information just makes the picture more confusing.

The acting is solid and keeps you guessing until the very end. While the pacing slows down a bit in the middle, the twists make up for it. It is a great pick if you love stories that play with your head. Just settle in and try to solve the mystery before the characters do.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the man in the coma is not actually any of their missing loved ones. He is a con artist who had plastic surgery to look like several different people. He planned this whole thing to trick these people into giving him money and secrets. In the end, he wakes up and reveals his true identity. The movie wraps up by showing that the people were just pawns in a very clever game.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological puzzles and plot twists.
